text:
sam: Quick sync — we need to lock launch gating for Dedicated reserved pools. Customers want predictable burst, but ops cost is higher.

jess: Can we enumerate minimum SLOs required for GA? I think we agreed on p95 < 250ms and <0.2% errors but need confirmation.

liam: Engineering prefers p95 < 200ms for default tier. Anything softer will need extra isolation.

nora: SRE: agree on p95 200ms target. Also need an observability checklist: token-level latency histograms, tail traces, cost per 1k tokens.

sam: Proposed gating list: 1) Stability: <0.2% errors for 24h smoke tenants 2) Latency: p95 <200ms 3) Autoscale: can spin worker within 60s 4) Burst: allow 2x baseline for 5min without SLA breach

jess: For customers on reserved contracts, do we want burst to be unpaid or consume burst credits? Sales needs clarity.

liam: Technical tradeoff: supporting 2x short burst requires warm standby or fast prewarming logic. That adds infra cost.

nora: Alternative: auto-fallback to a slightly cheaper model when headroom is exhausted. Less infra but more quality variance.

jess: Sales input: offering a small burst allowance included in monthly commit helps close deals. Need clear billing text.

sam: Action items: liam to prototype prewarm vs fallback; nora to write observability acceptance; jess to draft commit + burst wording.

liam: Prototype note: two approaches
```
- prewarm: keep 1 reserved worker warm per pool; cost ~ +15%
- fallback: route to compatible quantized model; quality delta TBD
```

nora: Observability checklist (short):
- synthetic tenant smoke every 5m
- alert if p95 > 220ms for 15m
- daily burst utilization report

jess: Launch docs need explicit customer-facing guarantees + 'what happens when burst exhausted' flow.

sam: Decision proposal: GA gating requires stability + observability + either prewarm OR documented fallback. We accept fallback if we document expected quality variance.

liam: I'll run perf tests next week and post numbers in this thread. If prewarm cost >20% we use fallback.

nora: Ops note: cooldown behavior for autoscale should default to 60s, but make it configurable per tenant.

sam: Great. Tagging @deploy-bot to open tracking ticket.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: RDW-5461 — 'Dedicated GA gating checklist & burst policy' (assignee: sam). :white_check_mark:

jess: thanks. sync in 48h after perf numbers come in. :rocket:
